[EN] Hendry's got his hands full running his scouts and infiltrators. He's a good soldier but I worry about him.

He's sending out kids and they're dying. It's got to be eating him up inside.
[ES] Hendry tiene las manos ocupadas dirigiendo a sus exploradores e infiltrados. Es un buen soldado, pero me preocupa.

Está mandando chicos y están muriendo. Eso debe estar carcomiéndolo por dentro.
